gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-rowan: Pixelify Sans draws blocky, bold letters where every curve is as heavy as its stems, like cord. Rowan slips in beneath, rounded and slightly swelling, to soften it.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-paquito: Revalia stretches out wide and loose, with a g whose lower curve stays open and short stalks over tall letters. Paquito follows with a confident text serif whose lowercase sits close to its caps; sized modestly, the heading still holds up.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-fs-rowan: Rowan has a classic serif's lightly shaded texture, thin strokes at roughly half the weight of thick ones, and generous curves. And Shantell Sans above it keeps its terminals the same width they began, so the two feel like friendly rivals.
gen-gf-sniglet-fs-rowan: Round, rodlike and cheerfully blunt. Sniglet holds one weight with no accents, while Rowan, a text serif with modest swings in stroke weight, gives a long passage a restful, literary pace.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-paquito: Paquito is a confident text serif whose lowercase sits tight against its caps, set under a stencil-cut heading with tall letters and wide bridges. Make Snowburst One small and those bridges crowd.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-paquito: Paquito sits low, a text serif with little gap between lowercase and caps. Tektur does the showing off, with outsized lowercase and pipe-cleaner strokes, while Paquito simply settles in and gets on with the reading.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-paquito: Tilt Neon's tube-like strokes, like twine pressed into a flat surface, carry a splayed c and a large x-height under short ascenders. Paquito then drops in as a low, approachable serif, tucking its lowercase close to its caps.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-rowan: Rowan, a classic serif with generous curves and a mild thick and thin variation, is gentle and literary in the text. Turret Road does the commanding, with round forms like open parentheses and no swing in its line.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-rowan: Underdog cuts every curve to a single depth, with a c opened wide like a horseshoe. But Rowan, a text serif with slight thick-thin variation, makes the page feel warmer; shrink the heading and that boldness fades.
